newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian plane makes emergency landing in Bogota.
newsitem.headline: Colombian plane makes emergency landing in Bogota.

text.p: A Colombian plane bound for London with 154 passengers made an emergency landing at Bogota's international airport on Monday night after problems with its landing gear, airport officials said.
Shortly after the Avianca Boeing 767 took off from Bogota's El Dorado airport, the pilot reported he was unable to retract the craft's forward landing gear.
The plane circled above Bogota for the next three and a half hours jettisoning fuel before landing safely.

"This was a minor problem. We ordered the plane to make the unscheduled landing as a purely preventative measure," airport manager Francisco Hernandez said. "There was no panic on board. Everybody was fine," he added.
The passengers were transferred to another plane and later departed again for London. Avianca has a twice weekly non-stop flight to London from Bogota.
